metaTitle: Jaguar Failed Previous Rebuild Remediation | Jaguar Garage
metaDescription: Professional assessment and correction of poorly-rebuilt Jaguar engines. We strip, inspect, and re-do work from other workshops to get your engine right.
lede: Professional assessment and correction for Jaguar engines that have been incorrectly rebuilt by another workshop.

blocks.html: When a Jaguar engine arrives that was previously rebuilt by another workshop and is not performing correctly, we carry out a systematic assessment to identify what was done incorrectly and correct it. Our focus is on the actions we take to put the engine right — not on why the previous work might have failed.

chips.label: **Full visual inspection** – we examine the engine externally for signs of improper assembly, missing components, or incorrect fittings.
**Comprehensive strip-down** – we disassemble the engine to verify every aspect of the previous rebuild, including timing chain alignment, bearing clearances, and bolt torques.
**Verification of work done** – we check that all components are correct for the engine and that they were installed to manufacturer specifications.
**Identification of corrective work** – we compile a detailed list of what needs to be re-done, replaced, or adjusted, and provide a fixed-price quote for the remediation.
**Timing verification and correction** – we re-check and re-set cam and crank timing using factory tools to ensure precise alignment.
**Torque and clearance checks** – we re-torque all critical fasteners to correct settings and verify bearing and piston clearances.
**Component replacement** – any parts that were incorrectly installed, damaged, or substandard are replaced with OEM or equivalent quality items.
**Full reassembly to factory standards** – we rebuild the engine from the ground up using our documented process, ensuring every step meets Jaguar specifications.
**Post-remediation testing** – we run the engine, perform diagnostics, and road-test the vehicle to confirm correct operation.

items.q: What does a failed rebuild remediation involve?
items.a: We start with a full strip-down inspection to verify all previous work – checking timing alignment, torque settings, component condition, and clearances. Then we correct any issues by re-timing, re-torquing, replacing faulty parts, and reassembling to factory specifications, followed by thorough testing.

items.q: How long does a failed rebuild remediation take?
items.a: The duration depends on the extent of the issues found. Typically, a full assessment takes 1–2 days, and the correction work can take an additional 3–7 days depending on what needs to be re-done. We provide a clear timeline after inspection.

items.q: Can you fix any previous rebuild, regardless of who did it?
items.a: Yes – we specialise in correcting work from other workshops. We approach every engine with fresh eyes, strip it down fully, and rebuild it correctly using our established processes and factory specifications.

items.q: Will I get a warranty on the remediation work?
items.a: Yes – our remediation work is backed by the same 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty we offer on all our engine rebuilds and repairs.

items.q: What if the previous rebuild was done with non-genuine parts?
items.a: During our inspection we identify any substandard parts and replace them with OEM or equivalent quality components. We only use parts that meet or exceed Jaguar specifications.
